sources.entry: Quicksilver - Quicksilver is a fast macOS productivity application that gives you the power to control your Mac quickly and elegantly.

summary.one_liner: Quicksilver is a free, fast macOS productivity application for controlling your Mac quickly, and this repository holds its source code.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Quicksilver as a macOS app that lets you control your Mac quickly and learns your habits to simplify everyday tasks. This repository contains the source code for the main app, and the main branch holds the source for the currently released version. It points to an issue tracker for browsing and opening issues. It also links to a developer map and a Wiki page on building Quicksilver. The README warns that building and testing from source should be preceded by backing up user data in the Application Support, Caches, and Preferences folders. It also notes that multiple copies of Quicksilver.app can break Services and AppleScript.
use_cases: launch apps and control the Mac quickly
contribute to a macOS productivity app
browse or report issues for Quicksilver
how_to_run: Follow the Quicksilver Wiki instructions on Building Quicksilver
notable: Learns user habits to make everyday tasks simpler, per the README
Main branch tracks the currently released version
Developer map and support groups for newcomers
caveats: Building from source requires following a separate Wiki guide, and the README does not describe the steps itself
Running source builds alongside a released copy can break Services and AppleScript, so the README advises keeping only one Quicksilver.app
The README tells users to back up data before trying the source
